subject: Upload (updated) file with same file name as currently loaded

messages.author: b419b3f42893b2f1
messages.subject: Upload (updated) file with same file name as currently loaded
parts:
Hi all,

I have made a couple of Shiny apps where you start the analysis by uploading a csv file. Sometimes I want to make small changes and re-upload the csv file. When I try this I find that I need to rename the file, or my apps won't really re-read it after it is uploaded again. 

So, everything works as expected if the I rename the file, but is there a way to make the app actually re-read the data if the new file has the same file names as the one currently loaded?

Thanks!

messages.author: a1bf76ab9a5a2d4b
messages.subject: Re: Upload (updated) file with same file name as currently loaded
parts: I don't think this is shiny behaviour, I think the way file inputs in HTML work is that they only fire when they get a new file chosen. Re-choosing the file if it's the currently chosen file will not do anything. I think you have to manually choose a different file, and then again choose the original file.  Does that make sense?  I'm not 100% sure, but I think that's how file inputs work from what I remember
